title: Charge Air Temperature High Speed Derate
detail_of_failure: The temperature by the charge (boost) pressure and temperature sensor exceeds the upper control limit.
controller_action: Operates the machine with the engine output limited.
machine_effect: • Engine output is reduced. • Engine stops.
related_information: • Boost temperature can be checked with monitoring function. (Code: 18500) • After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Turn the starting switch to the ON position.

steps.procedure: Cooling performance of the aftercooler can be lowered. Check it for the items that follow. • Loosened or damaged fan belt • Insufficient cooling air volume • Clogged aftercooler fin
It is possible that there is an abnormal temperature rise of the turbocharger outlet. Check the related parts.
If no failure is found by the above check, the charge temperature sensor system can be defective. Do the troubleshooting for failure codes [CA153] and [CA154].
